resources.string: %1$s finds your documents, photos and screenshots by their names and the words in them.
It reads your files here, with nothing to download. Nothing is sent to a server.
%1$s of %2$s read · working out how long
Names come first, so search works almost at once. Reading the words inside your documents, PDFs and photos takes longer.
Quick. Lets you find a file by its name.
Slower. Lets you find a file by the words written in it, including the text in photos.
Search your files by their names and the words in them
Names work now and words are still being read, so more matches may appear.
Search finds files by their names and the words in them, entirely on this phone.

%1$s deletes its index of your files now: their names, the words in your documents, and the text it read in photos and screenshots. Its temporary files and any problem reports go too.

Your own files are not touched. Your settings stay, including the folders you skipped.

%1$s then stops reading. Search stays empty until you tap Resume.
The battery is under 30%%, so %1$s waits to save what is left. It carries on by itself once the phone charges.
